about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Japanese Cotton Cheesecake
recipes.summary: A jiggly, light-as-air baked cheesecake with a whipped egg white meringue and a soft golden top.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C and line a 18cm round tin with baking paper, then set it in a roasting dish.
Warm the cream cheese, milk and butter in a bowl over simmering water, stirring until smooth, then cool slightly and whisk in the yolks.
Sift in the flour and cornflour and whisk until smooth.
Beat the egg whites with the lemon juice until foamy, add the sugar in three batches and whisk until soft peaks form.
Fold the meringue into the cheese mixture in three batches, pour into the tin and add hot water to the roasting dish to come halfway up the tin.
Bake for 60 minutes until golden and gently set with a slight wobble, then cool in the oven with the door ajar.
notes: Food safety: bake until the centre is set. Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Honey Castella Sponge Loaf
recipes.summary: A moist, dense Japanese-style honey sponge with a fine crumb and a caramelised top.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C and line a loaf tin with baking paper.
Warm the eggs and sugar in a bowl over simmering water, whisking until the sugar dissolves, then whisk off the heat for 8 minutes until thick and tripled in volume.
Warm the honey, milk and oil and fold into the batter, then sift in the flour and fold until just combined.
Pour into the tin, tap out large bubbles and bake for 45 minutes until deep golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin, wrapped in baking paper, so the top stays moist.
notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian. Food safety: the sponge must be fully baked through.

recipes.title: Lemon Butter Mochi Squares
recipes.summary: Chewy, buttery glutinous rice flour squares with lemon and coconut milk.
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C and grease a 20cm square tin.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, coconut milk, milk, butter, vanilla, zest and lemon juice until smooth.
Mix in the glutinous rice flour and baking powder until no lumps remain.
Pour into the tin and bake for 50 minutes until the top is deep golden and the centre is set.
Cool completely before cutting into squares.
notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Haupia Coconut Pudding Squares
recipes.summary: Silky set coconut squares from just coconut milk, sugar and cornflour, chilled and cut.
steps: Whisk the cornflour with the water until smooth.
Heat the coconut milk and sugar in a pot over medium heat until steaming, then whisk in the cornflour mixture.
Stir constantly for 5 minutes until the mixture is thick and glossy.
Pour into a lined 18cm tin, smooth the top and chill until set.
Cut into squares and sprinkle with toasted desiccated coconut.
notes: Plus 3 hours chilling. Snack. Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Hawaiian-Style Sweet Bread Rolls
recipes.summary: Soft, slightly sweet pineapple-scented rolls with a shiny honey-butter top.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, then add the pineapple juice, milk, half the butter and the egg and knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover and prove until doubled in size, then shape into 12 balls and arrange snugly in a tin.
Prove again for 30 minutes until puffy. Heat the oven to 180°C.
Bake for 22 minutes until golden, then brush with the remaining butter mixed with the honey.
Cool slightly and pull apart to serve.
notes: Plus 2 hours proving. Snack. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Samoan-Style Coconut Buns
recipes.summary: Soft yeasted buns filled with sweet toasted coconut and brushed with a sugar glaze.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, caster sugar and salt, then add the warm coconut milk and egg and knead for 8 minutes until smooth.
Cover and prove until doubled, then divide into 12 balls and flatten.
Mix the desiccated coconut, brown sugar and butter until combined, put a spoonful in each round and pinch closed.
Place seam down on a tray, prove for 20 minutes, then bake at 180°C for 22 minutes until deep golden.
Mix the icing sugar with a spoonful of water and brush over the warm buns.
notes: Plus 1 hour 30 minutes proving. Snack. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Pineapple Coconut Upside-Down Cake
recipes.summary: A buttery caramelised pineapple topping over a coconut sponge, turned out while warm.
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a 20cm round tin.
Melt the first butter with the brown sugar until bubbling, pour into the tin and arrange the pineapple on top.
Beat the softened butter and caster sugar for 3 minutes until pale, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Fold in the flour, coconut milk and desiccated coconut, and spoon over the fruit.
Bake for 40 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean, rest for 5 minutes, then turn out.
notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Honey Ginger Yakgwa-Style Cookies
recipes.summary: Soft, flaky deep-fried cookies soaked in a warm ginger and honey syrup.
steps: Rub the flour with the sesame oil, then mix in the rice wine and enough water to make a firm dough.
Roll out 1cm thick, cut into small diamonds and prick with a fork.
Simmer the honey, 1/2 cup water, ginger and cinnamon for 5 minutes until syrupy, then keep warm.
Fry the cookies in the oil at 140°C for 8 minutes until golden, drain well, then soak in the syrup for 30 minutes.
Lift out, top with pine nuts and serve at room temperature.
notes: Plus 30 minutes soaking. Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Milk Bread Buns
recipes.summary: Fluffy milk buns swirled with a spiced sweet potato filling.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, then add the warm milk, egg and butter and knead for 12 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover and prove until doubled, then divide into 12 pieces and roll each into an oval.
Mix the sweet potato, brown sugar and cinnamon until smooth, spread over each oval, roll up and tuck the ends under.
Place seam down in a tray, prove again for 30 minutes until puffy and bake at 180°C for 25 minutes until deep golden.
Cool on a rack before serving.
notes: Plus 2 hours proving. Snack. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Steamed Honeycomb Sponge Cake
recipes.summary: A light, airy steamed cake with a springy honeycomb crumb and a gentle caramel flavour.
steps: Line a 18cm tin and set up a steamer over simmering water.
Whisk the eggs and sugar for 8 minutes until thick and pale.
Fold in the flour and baking powder, then the oil, milk and vanilla until just combined.
Pour into the tin, cover the tin loosely with foil and steam on medium heat for 30 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes before slicing.
notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian. Food safety: steam until fully set in the centre.

recipes.title: Hong Kong-Style Egg Waffle Bubbles
recipes.summary: Crisp-edged, chewy bubble waffles made from a sweet vanilla batter.
steps: Whisk the eggs, sugar, milk, oil and vanilla until smooth.
Mix in the flour, cornflour and baking powder, then rest.
Heat a waffle pan and pour in enough batter to fill the holes.
Cook for 3 minutes per waffle until deep golden and crisp, then cool briefly so it crisps further.
Serve warm, torn into pieces.
notes: Plus 10 minutes resting. Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Soy Milk Pudding Cups with Orange Syrup
recipes.summary: Silky set soy milk pudding with a bright orange syrup.
steps: Whisk the cornflour with 1/2 cup of the soy milk until smooth.
Heat the remaining soy milk with the caster sugar until steaming, whisk in the cornflour mixture and stir for 4 minutes until thick, then add the vanilla.
Pour into 6 cups and chill until set.
Simmer the orange juice and white sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy, then cool.
Top the puddings with the syrup and orange segments.
notes: Plus 3 hours chilling. Snack. Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Thai Coconut Cream Pudding Cups with Lime
recipes.summary: Cool, creamy coconut pudding cups with a sharp lime syrup.
steps: Whisk the cornflour with 1/2 cup of the water until smooth.
Heat the coconut milk, remaining water and caster sugar until steaming, whisk in the cornflour mixture and stir for 4 minutes until thick.
Pour into 6 cups and chill until set.
Simmer the lime juice and white sugar for 4 minutes until syrupy, then cool.
Spoon the syrup over the puddings.
notes: Plus 3 hours chilling. Snack. Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Caramel Flan with Coconut
recipes.summary: Silky baked custard with a bittersweet caramel top, enriched with coconut milk.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C. Cook the white sugar and water over medium heat for 6 minutes without stirring until deep amber, then pour into 6 ramekins.
Whisk the eggs, milk, coconut milk, caster sugar and vanilla until smooth, and strain.
Pour over the caramel and set the ramekins in a roasting dish. Add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake for 35 minutes until set with a gentle wobble in the centre.
Chill, then run a knife around each flan and turn out.
notes: Food safety: bake until the custard is set. Plus 3 hours chilling. Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Steamed Rice Honeycomb Cake
recipes.summary: A bouncy honeycomb-textured steamed cake made from rice flour and tapioca starch.
steps: Whisk the water, coconut milk and sugar, then stir in the yeast and rest until foamy.
Mix in the rice flour, tapioca starch and baking powder to a smooth runny batter and rest.
Pour into a lined 18cm tin and steam over simmering water for 30 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool completely before cutting into squares.
notes: Plus 45 minutes resting. Snack. Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Indonesian Layered Spice Cake
recipes.summary: A rich buttery cake built from thin spiced layers grilled one at a time.
steps: Heat the grill on high until very hot and line a 20cm tin.
Beat the butter and sugar for 5 minutes until pale, then beat in the yolks and vanilla.
Fold in the flour, then divide the batter in two and mix the spices into one half.
Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks and fold half into each batter.
Spread 3 tbsp of plain batter in the tin and grill for 3 minutes until golden. Alternate with spiced layers, grilling each until golden, until all the batter is used.
Cool completely before slicing thinly.
notes: Food safety: each layer must be cooked through with no wet batter. Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Palm Sugar Coconut Rice Balls
recipes.summary: Chewy glutinous rice balls hiding molten palm sugar, rolled in fresh coconut.
steps: Mix the flour, water and turmeric into a soft dough.
Roll into 18 small balls, press a piece of palm sugar into each and seal.
Boil in water for 4 minutes until they float, then boil for 1 minute more.
Toss the balls in the desiccated coconut mixed with the salt.
Serve warm, as the sugar centres are very hot.
notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Baked Tapioca Coconut Cake
recipes.summary: A dense, chewy baked coconut tapioca cake with a golden top.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease a 20cm tin.
Whisk the coconut milk, sugar, eggs, vanilla and salt until smooth.
Stir in the tapioca starch and desiccated coconut until no lumps remain.
Pour into the tin and bake for 50 minutes until golden on top and set in the centre.
Cool completely before cutting.
notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Pineapple Jam Tarts
recipes.summary: Buttery shortcrust tarts filled with homemade spiced pineapple jam.
steps: Pulse the flour, butter and icing sugar until it looks like crumbs, add one egg and mix to a dough, then rest.
Simmer the pineapple, caster sugar, cinnamon and star anise for 30 minutes, stirring often, until thick and jammy.
Cool the jam and remove the spices. Heat the oven to 170°C.
Roll the dough, cut 20 rounds, fill each with a spoonful of jam, and decorate with dough strips.
Brush with the second egg beaten, then bake for 20 minutes until golden.
notes: Food safety: bake until the pastry is golden and set. Plus 30 minutes resting the dough. Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Ensaymada Cheese Brioche Rolls
recipes.summary: Soft, buttery spiral brioche rolls topped with butter, sugar and cheese.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, 1/3 cup sugar and salt, then add the warm milk and eggs and knead for 12 minutes.
Work in the 120g butter a little at a time and knead for 8 minutes more until silky and elastic.
Cover and prove until doubled, then divide into 12, roll into ropes and coil into spirals in a tray.
Prove again for 40 minutes, then bake at 180°C for 22 minutes until golden.
Brush the warm rolls with the remaining butter and top with the remaining sugar and the grated cheddar.
notes: Plus 2 hours proving. Snack. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Mamon Chiffon Cupcakes
recipes.summary: Tall, airy chiffon sponge cups with a buttery, sugar-dusted top.
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C and line a 12-hole muffin tin with tall paper cups.
Whisk the yolks with half the sugar, oil, milk and vanilla until smooth, then fold in the flour and baking powder.
Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks, add the remaining sugar and whisk until glossy and stiff.
Fold the meringue into the batter in three batches, fill the cups and bake for 22 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Brush with butter and dust with a little extra sugar.
notes: Food safety: bake until fully set. Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Bibingka Baked Rice Cakes with Cheddar
recipes.summary: Fluffy rice-flour cakes baked with coconut milk and topped with melted butter and a cheese crust.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and grease six small ramekins.
Whisk the coconut milk, sugar, eggs and butter until smooth.
Mix in the rice flour and baking powder, fill the ramekins and bake for 15 minutes.
Top with cheddar and coconut and bake for 10 minutes more until the tops are golden and bubbling.
Serve warm with extra melted butter.
notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Biko Sticky Rice Cake with Coconut Caramel
recipes.summary: Chewy glutinous rice cooked in coconut milk and topped with a thick coconut caramel.
steps: Rinse the rice, then simmer with the coconut milk, water, 3/4 cup brown sugar and salt for 25 minutes, stirring often, until thick and tender.
Press the rice into a lined 20cm tin.
Simmer the coconut cream and 1/4 cup sugar for 8 minutes until thick and caramel-coloured.
Spread the topping over the rice and cool before cutting.
notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Orange Semolina Cake with Cardamom Syrup
recipes.summary: A moist baked semolina cake soaked in a fragrant orange and cardamom syrup.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease a 20cm tin.
Mix the semolina, flour, baking powder and caster sugar, then stir in the butter, yoghurt, eggs and orange zest until smooth.
Bake for 35 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Simmer the white sugar, water, orange juice and cardamom for 6 minutes until syrupy.
Pour the warm syrup over the hot cake and cool before cutting.
notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Cardamom Rose Cupcakes
recipes.summary: Soft buttery cupcakes scented with cardamom and rose water, topped with a pink glaze.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a 12-hole muffin tin.
Beat the butter and caster sugar for 4 minutes until pale, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Fold in the flour, 1/3 cup milk, cardamom and half the rose water.
Fill the cases and bake for 20 minutes until risen and golden.
Mix the icing sugar with the remaining rose water and milk, spread on the cooled cupcakes and top with pistachio.
notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Saffron Shrikhand Yoghurt Cups
recipes.summary: Thick strained yoghurt sweetened and scented with saffron and cardamom, topped with pistachio.
steps: Warm the milk and steep the saffron in it for 10 minutes.
Whisk the yoghurt, sugar, saffron milk and cardamom until smooth and glossy.
Spoon into cups and chill.
Top with pistachio just before serving.
notes: Plus 2 hours chilling. Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Mahamri Cardamom Coconut Doughnuts
recipes.summary: Pillowy triangle doughnuts spiced with cardamom and coconut milk, fried until golden.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, cardamom and salt, then add the warm coconut milk and knead for 8 minutes until smooth.
Cover and prove until doubled, then divide into 4 balls and roll each out 5mm thick.
Cut each into 3 triangles.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 175°C and fry the triangles for 2 minutes each side until puffed and golden.
Drain on paper and serve warm.
notes: Plus 1 hour proving. Snack. Vegan.

recipes.title: Ethiopian-Style Honey Spice Bread
recipes.summary: A soft, slightly sweet loaf with honey, cardamom and fennel.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, salt, cardamom and fennel, then stir in the water, honey and oil and knead for 10 minutes until smooth.
Cover and prove until doubled, shape into a round loaf and score the top.
Prove for 30 minutes, brush with beaten egg and bake at 190°C for 35 minutes until deep golden and hollow-sounding.
Cool on a rack before slicing.
notes: Plus 2 hours proving. Snack. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Koeksister Syrup Plaits
recipes.summary: Twisted doughnut plaits fried crisp and soaked in an ice-cold lemon-ginger syrup.
steps: Make the syrup first by simmering the sugar, water, lemon juice and ginger for 10 minutes until syrupy, then chill until ice cold.
Rub the butter into the flour and baking powder, then mix in the egg and milk to a soft dough and rest.
Roll out 1cm thick, cut into strips and plait three strips together.
Fry in the oil at 175°C for 3 minutes each side until deep golden.
Dip the hot plaits straight into the cold syrup for 1 minute, drain on a rack and serve.
notes: Plus 1 hour chilling the syrup and 30 minutes resting the dough. Snack. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Soetkoekies Spiced Sweet Biscuits
recipes.summary: Crisp, golden biscuits flavoured with ginger, cinnamon and a splash of sherry.
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C and line two trays.
Beat the butter and sugar for 3 minutes until pale, then beat in the egg and sherry.
Mix in the flour, baking powder and spices to a firm dough.
Roll out 5mm thick, cut into rounds and place on the trays.
Bake for 16 minutes until golden at the edges, then cool on the tray.
notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Fritters with Cinnamon Sugar
recipes.summary: Soft spiced pumpkin fritters fried until golden and rolled in cinnamon sugar.
steps: Mash the pumpkin, then stir in the flour, egg, milk and 1/2 tsp cinnamon to a thick batter.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat.
Fry spoonfuls for 3 minutes each side until puffed and golden brown.
Drain, then roll in the sugar mixed with the remaining cinnamon.
notes: Food safety: fry until the centre is cooked through. Snack. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Soy Poached Chicken with Ginger Spring Onion Oil
recipes.summary: Silky poached chicken sliced over rice with a hot ginger and spring onion oil.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a gentle simmer until just trembling, with half the ginger, the whole spring onions, wine and salt.
Lower in the chicken, cover, turn off the heat after 10 minutes of simmering and leave for 40 minutes until cooked through.
Check the thickest part of the thigh reads 75°C, then plunge the chicken into iced water for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, using a ladle of the poaching broth in place of some water.
Heat the neutral oil until shimmering and pour over the remaining ginger and sliced spring onion with the sesame oil and half the soy sauce.
Carve the chicken, serve over rice with the cucumber and spoon over the ginger oil and remaining soy sauce.
notes: Food safety: the thickest part of the thigh must reach 75°C and the juices run clear. Hot oil spits, so pour carefully.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Dan Dan Noodles with Spiced Pork
recipes.summary: Springy noodles in a nutty, tingly chilli sauce topped with crisp spiced pork mince.
steps: Fry the pork in the oil over high heat for 6 minutes until crisp and cooked through, adding the garlic and peppercorn for the last minute.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, chilli oil and 3 tbsp hot water until smooth.
Boil the noodles for 4 minutes until tender, adding the spinach for the last 30 seconds, then drain.
Toss the noodles with the sauce, top with the pork and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: pork mince must reach 75°C throughout with no pink.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Ginger Soy Steamed White Fish with Hot Oil
recipes.summary: Delicate steamed fish fillets topped with sizzling oil, ginger and spring onion.

items: 3 spring onion, cut into thin strips

steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Place the fish on a heatproof plate with half the ginger and spring onion and steam over high heat for 8 minutes until the flesh turns opaque and flakes easily.
Pour off the liquid, then mix the soy sauce, wine, sugar and sesame oil and pour over the fish.
Top with the remaining ginger, spring onion and coriander, then heat the oil until smoking and pour it over.
Serve straight away with rice.
notes: Food safety: the fish is cooked when it turns opaque and flakes with a fork. Hot oil spits, so pour carefully.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Braised Eggplant in Garlic Sauce
recipes.summary: Silky eggplant braised in a sweet, sour and spicy garlic sauce until glossy.
steps: Fry the eggplant in the oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat for 8 minutes until browned and soft, then lift out.
Fry the garlic, ginger and doubanjiang for 1 minute until the oil turns red.
Add the stock, soy sauce, vinegar and sugar and return the eggplant, then simmer for 8 minutes until the sauce is thick and clings.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve topped with spring onion.
notes: Dinner. Vegan.

recipes.title: Gyudon Beef and Onion Rice Bowls
recipes.summary: Thinly sliced beef and sweet onion simmered in a soy dashi sauce over rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky.
Simmer the dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar in a pan, add the onion and cook for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the beef and cook for 3 minutes, stirring, until no pink remains.
Spoon the beef and sauce over the rice and top with spring onion and pickled ginger.
notes: Food safety: thin beef slices are cooked once no pink remains and they reach 71°C.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Pan-Fried Mushroom and Cabbage Gyoza
recipes.summary: Crisp-bottomed dumplings filled with mushroom and cabbage, pleated by hand.
steps: Salt the wombok lightly for 10 minutes, squeeze out the liquid, then mix with the mushrooms, garlic, ginger, spring onion, 1 tbsp soy sauce and the sesame oil.
Place a spoonful of filling in each wrapper, wet the edge, then fold and pleat to seal.
Heat the oil in a wide non-stick pan and sit the gyoza flat-side down for 3 minutes until golden underneath.
Pour in the water, cover and steam for 5 minutes until the wrappers turn translucent and the water has gone.
Mix the remaining soy sauce with the vinegar for dipping.
notes: Dinner. Vegan.

recipes.title: Spicy Gochujang Chicken and Sweet Potato Pan
recipes.summary: Chicken thigh, cabbage and sweet potato stir-fried in a fiery gochujang sauce.
steps: Mix the gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce, honey and garlic and coat the chicken in it.
Cook the sweet potato in the oil in a wide pan over medium heat for 8 minutes until starting to soften.
Add the chicken, onion and cabbage and stir-fry for 12 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is sticky.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve the dakgalbi with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: the thickest piece of chicken must reach 75°C with no pink juices. Plus 30 minutes marinating.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Soy Braised Beef Short Rib Pot
recipes.summary: Beef chuck braised with daikon and carrot in a sweet soy sauce until falling apart.
steps: Boil the beef in water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse to remove scum.
Return the beef to the pot with the soy sauce, sugar, mirin, onion, garlic, ginger, sesame oil and 3 cups water.
Cover and simmer gently for 90 minutes until the beef is tender.
Add the daikon and carrot and simmer uncovered for 40 minutes until tender and the sauce is thick and glossy.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve the braise over the rice.
notes: Food safety: braised beef should reach at least 75°C in the centre and be fork-tender.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Sweet Soy Wide Noodles with Crisp Tofu
recipes.summary: Wide rice noodles charred in a sweet soy sauce with tofu and gai lan.
steps: Fry the tofu in 1 tbsp oil in a hot wok for 6 minutes until golden, then lift out.
Stir-fry the garlic in the remaining oil for 30 seconds, then add the noodles and press against the wok for 2 minutes until charred.
Add the gai lan and sauces with the sugar and toss for 3 minutes until the stalks are tender-crisp.
Return the tofu, toss and serve immediately.
notes: Dinner. Vegetarian (oyster sauce makes this not vegan; use mushroom-free soy for a vegan version).

recipes.title: Curried Pineapple Rice with Prawns and Cashews
recipes.summary: Fragrant wok-fried rice with sweet pineapple, prawns and cashews.
steps: Use cold, day-old rice that was cooled and refrigerated within 1 hour of cooking.
Fry the garlic in the oil over high heat for 30 seconds, push aside and scramble the eggs for 1 minute until set.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink and opaque, then add the rice, curry powder and soy sauce and toss for 4 minutes until hot.
Toss through the pineapple, cashews and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cool leftover rice and refrigerate it within 1 hour; prawns are cooked when pink and opaque. Reheat until steaming hot.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Shaking Beef Bo Luc Lac
recipes.summary: Cubes of seared beef tossed in a garlicky soy sauce and served on herbs with a lime dip.
steps: Marinate the beef with the garlic, soy sauce, oyster sauce and sugar.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Heat the oil in a wok until smoking and sear the beef in two batches for 2 minutes, shaking the pan, until browned outside and pink in the centre.
Arrange the rocket, red onion and tomato on plates and pile the beef on top.
Mix the lime juice, pepper and salt for dipping, and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: beef cubes should reach 63°C internal for medium or 71°C for well done. Plus 30 minutes marinating.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Chicken Satay Skewers with Peanut Sauce
recipes.summary: Turmeric-marinated chicken skewers with a rich peanut dipping sauce and cucumber.
steps: Mix the oil, turmeric, coriander, cumin, garlic and kecap manis and coat the chicken in it. Thread onto skewers.
Grill for 10 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Warm the peanut butter, coconut milk, soy sauce and lime juice for 4 minutes until smooth and thick.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve the skewers with the sauce, rice and cucumber.
notes: Food safety: the chicken must reach 75°C throughout with no pink juices. Plus 1 hour marinating.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Smoky Wok Rice Noodles with Prawns and Chives
recipes.summary: Wok-charred flat rice noodles with prawns, egg, bean sprouts and chives.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok until smoking, fry the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the prawns and cook for 2 minutes until pink and opaque.
Push the prawns aside, add the egg and scramble for 1 minute until set.
Add the noodles, soy sauce, kecap manis and sambal and toss on high heat for 4 minutes until charred in places.
Toss through the bean sprouts and chives for 1 minute and serve hot.
notes: Food safety: prawns are cooked when pink and opaque. Egg must be fully set.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Chicken Inasal-Style Grilled Thighs
recipes.summary: Lemongrass, vinegar and garlic marinated chicken thighs grilled and basted with annatto oil.
steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, ginger, vinegar, lemon juice and salt and marinate the chicken in it.
Warm the oil with the annatto seed for 3 minutes until orange, then strain.
Grill the chicken for 20 minutes, turning and basting with the annatto oil, until charred and cooked through.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve with the chicken and soy sauce.
notes: Food safety: the thickest part must reach 75°C with no pink juices. Plus 2 hours marinating.
Dinner. Dairy-free. Gluten-free (use tamari).

recipes.title: Goan Pork Vindaloo Pots
recipes.summary: Tender pork shoulder in a tangy, fiery vinegar and spice paste, served with rice.
steps: Grind the dried chilli, cumin, mustard seed, garlic, ginger, vinegar and turmeric to a paste and coat the pork in it.
Soften the onion in the oil in a heavy pot for 8 minutes until golden, then add the pork and brown for 6 minutes.
Add the sugar, water and salt, cover and simmer for 80 minutes until the pork is tender and the sauce is thick.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve the vindaloo over it.
notes: Food safety: the pork must reach at least 75°C in the centre and be fork-tender. Plus 3 hours marinating.
Dinner. Dairy-free. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Smoky Baingan Bharta Eggplant Mash
recipes.summary: Charred eggplant mashed with tomato, onion and spices and scooped with flatbread.
steps: Char the whole eggplants over a flame or under a hot grill for 20 minutes, turning, until the skin is blackened and the flesh collapses.
Cool, peel off the skin and mash the flesh.
Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, chilli, cumin, garam masala and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the tomato and cook for 8 minutes until broken down, then stir in the eggplant and cook for 5 minutes until thick.
Fold through the coriander and serve with warm naan.
notes: Dinner. Vegetarian (naan may contain dairy).

recipes.title: Paneer Tikka Skewers with Mint Chutney
recipes.summary: Marinated paneer, capsicum and onion grilled until charred, with a fresh mint chutney.
steps: Mix the yoghurt, ginger garlic paste, garam masala, chilli powder, lemon juice and oil, and coat the paneer and vegetables in it.
Thread onto skewers, alternating the paneer and vegetables.
Grill for 12 minutes, turning, until charred at the edges and the paneer is golden.
Serve with the mint chutney and warm naan.
notes: Plus 1 hour marinating. Dinner. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Ugandan Groundnut Chicken Stew
recipes.summary: Chicken thighs simmered with tomato, onion and ground peanut in a thick, savoury stew.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a heavy pot for 8 minutes, then lift out.
Soften the onion for 6 minutes, add the garlic, ginger, cumin and coriander for 1 minute, then the tomato for 5 minutes.
Stir in the peanut butter and stock, return the chicken and simmer for 30 minutes until the sauce is thick and the chicken is tender.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve alongside.
notes: Food safety: the chicken must reach 75°C throughout with no pink juices.
Dinner. Dairy-free. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Cape Lamb and Potato Pot with Cinnamon Tomato
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked lamb and tomato stew with potato, warm spices and a touch of sugar.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in a heavy pot for 10 minutes until deeply coloured, then lift out.
Soften the onion for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, cinnamon, tomatoes, paste, sugar and salt.
Return the lamb with the water, cover and simmer gently for 80 minutes.
Add the potato and cook for 30 minutes more until the lamb and potato are very tender.
Remove the cinnamon stick and serve in bowls.
notes: Food safety: the lamb should be tender and reach at least 70°C in the centre of the largest piece.
Dinner. Dairy-free. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Chakalaka Beans with Garlic Bread
recipes.summary: Spicy South African-style vegetable relish stewed with beans, served with garlic toast.
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and capsicum in the oil for 8 minutes, then add 2 of the garlic, curry powder and chilli powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until thick, then stir in both beans and cook for 8 minutes until hot.
Mix the remaining garlic with the olive oil, brush over sliced bread and toast until golden.
Serve the chakalaka with the garlic bread.
notes: Dinner. Vegan. Use canned beans only; if cooking dried kidney beans, boil them hard for 10 minutes first.

recipes.title: Seared Tuna Poke-Style Rice Bowls
recipes.summary: Seared tuna steaks over rice with avocado, cucumber, edamame and a sesame soy dressing.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky, and cook the edamame in boiling water for 4 minutes until tender.
Sear the tuna in the oil in a very hot pan for 1 to 2 minutes each side until browned outside; for fully cooked, continue until the flesh turns opaque and flakes.
Whisk the soy sauce, sesame oil and vinegar.
Slice the tuna and arrange over the rice with avocado, cucumber and edamame.
Drizzle with the dressing and scatter with sesame seed and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: seared tuna is rare in the centre; cook until opaque and flaking for pregnant, elderly or immune-compromised people.
Dinner. Dairy-free.
